description.value: Frog Peak Café & Guesthouse has been serving breakfast and lunch on the edge of the Slocan River in Crescent Valley since 2005, with a strong commitment to locally sourced ingredients and rotating local artwork on the walls. The café sits on an acre of gardens and mature trees, offering a distinctly unhurried stop in one of BC's most scenic valley corridors. The self-contained upstairs guesthouse sleeping up to six people makes it a practical overnight option for cyclists touring the Slocan Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at frogpeakcafe.com was successfully fetched and serves as the primary evidence source. The OSM name 'Frog Creek Café' is incorrect; every page of the website consistently identifies the business as 'Frog Peak Café & Guesthouse', so the website value is used per rule 12 and the discrepancy is flagged. The contact page supplies the phone (250-359-7261) and address (1418 Highway #6, Crescent Valley, BC) not present in OSM; since OSM had no phone or address to cross-check, contact_confirmed for those fields is null. The menu pages confirm gluten-free and vegetarian options explicitly; no evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout labelling, or café-customer Wi-Fi appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null (OSM internet_access=wlan is not treated as authoritative and is only confirmed for the guesthouse suite in the website text).
concerns: OSM name 'Frog Creek Café' does not match the actual business name 'Frog Peak Café & Guesthouse' confirmed across all website pages; OSM record should be corrected.
OSM contains no phone number or address; both were sourced from the website contact page only, so contact_confirmed.phone and contact_confirmed.address are null.
OSM tag internet_access=wlan could not be confirmed for café customers; high-speed internet is mentioned on the website only in the context of the upstairs guesthouse suite.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, locally loved café with a strong vegetarian/GF menu and adjacent guesthouse accommodation in the Slocan Valley — a clear and useful listing for touring cyclists on this route.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple vegetarian-friendly dishes (Veghead panini with roasted peppers, artichokes, pesto and mozzarella; Huevos Rancheros with black beans and avocado; The Goddess Bagel; The Pesto Eggs Benedict); several items are explicitly marked 'Available gluten-free' and GF bread substitution is offered on paninis

wow_evidence: serving breakfast and lunch on the edge of the Slocan River in Crescent Valley since 2005
